feeds.name: arXiv cs.RO - Robotics

feeds.name: arXiv eess.SY - Systems and Control
feeds.note: Control theory underpinning real-world actuation.

feeds.name: arXiv cs.MA - Multiagent Systems

feeds.name: Science Robotics
feeds.note: Peer reviewed - the quality bar arXiv does not clear.

feeds.name: Nature Machine Intelligence
feeds.note: Peer reviewed. Embodied learning and robot foundation models.

feeds.name: IEEE Spectrum - Robotics
feeds.group: Physical AI - industry and installation data
feeds.note: Technically literate and fully open. The strongest robotics reporting on this list.

feeds.name: The Robot Report
feeds.group: Physical AI - industry and installation data
feeds.note: Funding rounds, deployments, order books. The trade press of record.

feeds.name: Robohub
feeds.group: Physical AI - industry and installation data
feeds.note: Researcher-written. Bridges the preprint literature and industry.

feeds.name: IFR World Robotics
feeds.group: Physical AI - industry and installation data
feeds.note: The authoritative robot installation statistics - functionally the BLS of robotics. No feed; poll the press page. Annual World Robotics report is the anchor dataset for automation economics.

feeds.name: A3 - Association for Advancing Automation
feeds.group: Physical AI - industry and installation data
feeds.note: North American robot order and shipment statistics. Returns 403 to bots - poll or license.

feeds.name: Fed G.17 - Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization
feeds.note: The core automation-economics primary series. Capacity utilization is the demand signal that precedes automation capex.

feeds.name: MIT Initiative on the Digital Economy
feeds.note: Where the Acemoglu/Autor-lineage work on automation and labour displacement surfaces first.

feeds.name: BLS Productivity and Costs
feeds.note: Via the API - PRS85006092 is nonfarm business output per hour. The series any automation-productivity claim must be checked against.

feeds.name: Census Annual Business Survey
feeds.note: Carries firm-level robotics and AI adoption questions. The only large-sample US adoption data. No feed.

feeds.name: EDGAR XBRL Frames API
feeds.note: One concept across every filer for one period - the single most useful endpoint here. Verified: this call returns 2,701 filers' capex for CY2025Q1, ranking Alphabet 17.2B, Microsoft 16.8B, Meta 12.9B. Swap the concept for ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense or any us-gaap tag. Caution: filers use different tags for the same economics, so a frame is a starting population, not a complete one.

feeds.name: EDGAR Company Facts API
feeds.note: Every XBRL fact a filer has ever reported, in one document. Zero-pad the CIK to ten digits (this example is NVIDIA).

feeds.name: EDGAR Company Concept API
feeds.note: One concept's full history for one filer, with the accession number behind each figure - so every number you publish is citable to a filing.

feeds.name: EDGAR Submissions API
feeds.note: Complete filing history and metadata for a filer. The entry point for tracking who filed what, when.

feeds.name: EDGAR Full-Text Search
feeds.note: Searches filing text, not just metadata. The way to track how language like physical AI or agentic spreads through 10-K risk factors - a leading indicator disclosure picks up before revenue does.

feeds.name: EDGAR Current Filings Stream
feeds.note: Real-time Atom feed of filings as they land. Change type= for 10-K, 10-Q, S-1. The fastest legitimate route to a material corporate event.

feeds.name: EDGAR Insider Transactions - Form 4
feeds.note: Officer and director trades, filed within two business days.

feeds.name: EDGAR Institutional Holdings - 13F
feeds.note: Institutional positions. Filed 45 days after quarter-end - stale by construction, so never report it as a current holding.

feeds.name: SEC Company Tickers Map
feeds.note: Ticker-to-CIK lookup. You need this before any other EDGAR call - fetch once and cache.

feeds.name: EDGAR Financial Statement Data Sets
feeds.note: Bulk quarterly ZIP of every filer's numeric XBRL data. Use this instead of thousands of API calls when doing cross-sectional work.

feeds.name: EDGAR Daily Index
feeds.note: Every filing accepted each day. The completeness backstop if a feed drops something.

feeds.name: SEC Press Releases
feeds.note: Enforcement actions and rulemaking. Pair with https://www.sec.gov/news/speeches-statements.rss for policy signals.

feeds.name: IEA - International Energy Agency
feeds.note: No RSS exists anywhere on iea.org - verified across eight candidate paths. Poll the analysis index. The authoritative source on datacenter electricity demand, now a first-order AI economics story.

feeds.name: EIA Today in Energy
feeds.note: US Energy Information Administration. Daily, chart-led, and open - the practical substitute for IEA's missing feed.

feeds.name: EIA Press Releases
feeds.note: Short-Term Energy Outlook and electricity demand projections.

feeds.name: Federal Register - artificial intelligence
feeds.note: JSON API, no key. The authoritative record of US rulemaking. Add conditions[type]=RULE to cut notice noise.

feeds.name: NIST News
feeds.note: Source for AI Risk Management Framework updates.

feeds.name: European Commission - Digital Strategy
feeds.note: Primary feed for EU AI Act implementation and guidance.

feeds.name: UK AI Security Institute
feeds.note: Atom. The gov.uk org slug is still ai-safety-institute after the rename.

feeds.name: CSET - Georgetown
feeds.note: Center for Security and Emerging Technology. Rigorous on compute, chips and China policy.

feeds.name: RAND
feeds.note: The AI-topic feed returns zero items; the press feed carries the same research.

feeds.name: BLS Release Calendar
feeds.note: Critical for a daily report. Major prints drop 08:30 ET on dates known months ahead.

feeds.name: Bureau of Economic Analysis
feeds.note: GDP, PCE price index (the Fed's preferred inflation gauge), trade balance.

feeds.name: Census Economic Indicators
feeds.note: Retail sales, housing starts, durable goods, business inventories.

feeds.name: Treasury Daily Yield Curve
feeds.note: Atom/OData XML, ~15:30 ET each business day. Increment the year parameter annually.

feeds.name: FRED - St. Louis Fed
feeds.note: Free key. The best aggregation layer - 800k+ series, normalised, with vintage and revision history.

feeds.name: Federal Reserve - Monetary Policy
feeds.note: FOMC statements and minutes. The highest-value single economics feed on this list.

feeds.name: Federal Reserve - Speeches
feeds.note: Where policy shifts are trailed before they are made.

feeds.name: BBC Business
feeds.note: The best fully-open general business wire substitute.

feeds.name: IEEE Spectrum - AI
feeds.note: The strongest technically-literate AI reporting that is fully open.

feeds.name: The Verge
feeds.note: High volume, consumer-tech skew. Filter hard.

feeds.name: Nature - News
feeds.note: Peer-reviewed research news across AI and robotics.
